description: S-K1 along-direction guard parity (DEL-04-03 Work skew-restraints.md section 7.1, R-1): boundary cases read by the RE reader (along_direction_evidence) and the Python verifier (_along_direction). Each value is a binary64 bit pattern (16 hex digits). `accept` is the guard's verdict under its one operation order: the canonical direction and the joint scaling by the same power-of-two steps, then left-to-right sums with no compensation and no fused multiply-add. Each pair of cases is the last accepted and first refused s on one side of s = d.R/|d| for a fixed d and R. The first case is re-check 2's counterexample, d = R = (1.0, 0.1, 0.6), s = 0x1.2ba3ebdc9a779p+0: refused.
